text_version.note: AGORA sections of the act only: West Virginia HB 2760 (2021), Sec 11-13Q "Credit allowed for specified high technology manufacturers."

territorial_scope.description: Credit applies against taxes imposed by West Virginia for qualified investment in facilities in this state.

evidence.quote: a new or expanded high technology manufacturing business in this state

summary.short: West Virginia code section 11-13Q-1Oa grants a 20-year credit of 100 percent of tax attributable to qualified investment in new or expanded high technology manufacturing businesses, covering electronics, semiconductors and, from 2022, drone, autonomous vehicle, robot, AI-operated machine, biotechnology and medical-device manufacturing, conditioned on 20 new jobs.
summary.long: West Virginia code section 11-13Q-1Oa allows an eligible high technology manufacturing business taxpayer a credit against state taxes equal to 100 percent of the tax attributable to its qualified investment in a new or expanded high technology manufacturing business in this state that creates at least 20 new jobs within 12 months after the investment is placed in service. The credit runs for a 20-year period, may be taken without carryover, and cannot be combined with other credits in the code for the same investment. Eligible activities are six-digit NAICS manufacturing codes for computers, electronic components and semiconductors; from tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2022, also drones, autonomous motor vehicles, robots, machines operated by and incorporating artificial intelligence, biotechnology products and medical devices. New jobs must pay a median compensation above $45,000 a year, adjusted annually by a consumer price index formula based on 2007. The commissioner may prescribe rules to determine and verify the credit and may require a notice of intent before estimated tax payments are reduced. The text defines artificial intelligence, autonomous, robot, drone and medical device.},

The text does not name the enacting bill or session law, so HB 2760 is not confirmed from the document. Internal issues: the proviso in (a) extends subdivision (2) to tax years beginning on and after January 1, 2022; the definition labelled (3)(C) 'Autonomous Motor Vehicle' is garbled and runs into the biotechnology definition, so no autonomous motor vehicle definition appears, and (3)(D) is missing; the numbering in (c)(3) (A), (8), (C), (D) is irregular. Sections 11-13Q-3 and 11-13Q-7 are not included in this excerpt.

"High technology manufacturing business" means a manufacturing activity properly classified as having one or more of the following six-digit North American Industry Classification System code numbers.

definitions.term: high technology manufacturing business (expanded categories for tax years beginning on and after January 1, 2022)

evidence.quote: for tax years beginning on and after January 1, 2022, the term "high technology manufacturing business" means and is limited to only those businesses engaged in a business enumerated in subdivision (1) or subdivision (2), or both, of this subsection

computers and computer systems that, by design and function, perform tasks that would typically require human intelligence, including decision-making, visual perception, speech recognition, or translation of one human language into another human language.

"autonomous" means that set of characteristics of a machine which taken as a whole cause the machine to be capable of performing designated tasks without immediate direct or explicit human control or intervention beyond initial programming and preliminary set up and initiation.
Biotechnology includes, but is not limited to, recombinant DNA techniques, genetics and genetic engineering, cell fusion techniques, and bioprocesses, using living organisms, or parts of organisms.

"Biotechnology product" means any virus, therapeutic serum, antibody, protein, toxin, antitoxin, vaccine, blood, blood component or derivative, allergenic product, or analogous product produced through the application of biotechnology that is used in the prevention, treatment, or cure of diseases or injuries to humans, animals, or plants.
"drone" means an unmanned aircraft that may be controlled either remotely or by an autonomous system, which may work with internal systemic sensors or ground positioning satellite systems, or both.
"Medical device" means an instrument, apparatus, implement, machine, contrivance, implant, in vitro reagent, or other similar or related article, including any component, part, or accessory, that is:
"robot" means a programmable machine, for which operating instructions are typically derived from computer programming, which machine is:

the cost-of-living adjustment for any calendar year is the percentage, if any, by which the consumer price index for the preceding calendar year exceeds the consumer price index for the calendar year 2007.

evidence.quote: the consumer price index for any calendar year is the average of the federal consumer price index as of the close of the 12-month period ending on August 31 of such calendar year.
the term "Federal Consumer Price Index" means the last consumer price index for all urban consumers published by the United States Department of Labor.

obligations.summary: A taxpayer's qualified investment in a new or expanded high technology manufacturing business must result in at least 20 new jobs within 12 months after the investment is placed into service, for the credit under subsection (b)(1) to be allowed.
obligations.conditional_on: Qualified investment in a new or expanded high technology manufacturing business in this state placed into service

evidence.quote: which results in the creation of at least 20 new jobs within 12 months after placing qualified investment into service

obligations.summary: A taxpayer may elect to delay the start of the 20-year credit period until the next succeeding taxable year, by making the election in the annual income tax return for the year the qualified investment is first placed in service; once made, the election cannot be revoked.
obligations.conditional_on: Qualified investment placed into service or use in this state

evidence.quote: unless the taxpayer elects to delay the beginning of the 20-year credit period until the next succeeding taxable year

obligations.summary: New jobs must be directly attributable to the qualified investment, with median compensation above $45,000 per year (adjusted for inflation each year under subsection (c)(3)); failure to meet the median compensation requirement in a year results in forfeiture of the credit for that year. Related individuals and certain rehired employees are excluded from new employees under subsection (c)(1).
obligations.conditional_on: Jobs attributable to the qualified investment under subsection (c)(2)

evidence.quote: The median compensation of the new jobs attributable to the qualified investment is greater than $45,000 per year

obligations.summary: A taxpayer that has taken the credit under this section may not take the credit under any other section of the article, or under any other provision of the code, for the same qualified investment.
obligations.conditional_on: Credit under this section taken for the qualified investment

evidence.quote: not be eligible for application of the credit allowed under any other section of this article

evidence.quote: The commissioner may prescribe such rules as he or she determines necessary

obligations.summary: A taxpayer that intends to claim the credit must file with the commissioner a notice of intent to claim the credit before it begins reducing its monthly or quarterly installment payments of estimated tax.

enforcement.note: No fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, suspension or blocking provisions appear in the text. Section 11-13Q-1(c)(3) states that failure to meet the median compensation requirement results in forfeiture of the credit for that year, but the text names no authority, penalty maximum or enforcement procedure for it, so it is not coded as an enforcement regime. Section 11-13Q-1(e) and (f) give the commissioner rule-making and notice powers only.
